harness.notes: js/engine/audio.js has no imports and touches nothing at load time. wake() creates the context; music() called before wake() only stores music.want and is never replayed, so init must call wake() first. Each tune fades in over 0.5 s; bar scheduler on setInterval(150ms) with 0.6 s look-ahead. Default bgm volume 0.7.

notes: loopSec = chords (bars) x 4 beats x 60/bpm; the melody is composed deterministically from each tune's seed, so the loop repeats exactly. Map -> tune from music fields in js/data/maps.js; story scenes call D.music() in js/story/ch*.js.
